summary: Phase B Monte Carlo Simulators (Soccer/NBA/Tennis) end-to-end verified. All 22 pytest cases pass (sim schemas for all 4 sports, UFC 404, backtest aggregate + sport filter, NBA/Tennis calibration within ±10pp, sim_runner routing, apply_simulations mutation, unit tests for moneyline/totals/btts/atgs/points/threes etc). Frontend SimulatorPanel renders correctly on Soccer (PHASE B + 'Poisson goals (Dixon-Coles)' + λ PICK/λ OPP/MARKET), NBA (PHASE B + 'per-possession' + MARGIN/PROJ/λ), Tennis (PHASE B + 'per-point Markov chain' + PICK SRV/OPP SRV/AVG GAMES), MLB (PHASE A + 'MLB Stats API' regression preserved). All existing panels (LockV2, MarketRank) still render. No red screen errors. Minor schema gap noted in sim-backtest empty-rows path.

minor.issue: When zero settled picks have sim_win_probability stored (current state), by_sport is returned as empty dict {} rather than populated with all 4 SUPPORTED_SPORTS keys (MLB/Soccer/NBA/Tennis) each carrying {n:0, message:'No settled picks yet.'}. The spec line says 'by_sport with keys MLB, Soccer, NBA, Tennis (each may show n=0 with message)'. Current behavior is functionally correct (frontend can fall back to aggregate message) but UI may want predictable keys. Fix in brain/sim_backtest.py lines 177-185: when all_rows is empty AND sport is None, populate by_sport with the per-sport n=0 placeholders the same way the populated branch does at lines 191-200.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow". Not in sim files — pre-existing from earlier iterations, carried over from iteration_23. No new RN warnings introduced by Phase B.

action_items: Optional: populate by_sport with all 4 sport keys (n=0, message) in brain/sim_backtest.py when all_rows is empty and sport filter is None — matches spec wording exactly. Currently returns {} so frontend just shows the top-level n=0 message which is acceptable.
critical_code_review_comments: sim_runner._SPORTS_WITH_SIM correctly extended to {MLB, Soccer, NBA, Tennis}; apply_simulations mutates picks in-place with sim_* fields and lock-score lift — verified in test_apply_simulations_mutates.

sim_nba uses _calibrate_lambda (bisection) anchored to model_wp at the line, plus ±5% factor adjustments — explains the deliberately tight delta (NBA pick 7a0eee4d shows sim_wp 61.5 vs model 60.5 = 1pp). Tennis uses serve-gap calibration the same way (Tennis pick 6fcdec67: 75.5 vs 74.6 = 0.9pp). Both within ±10pp guardrail as expected.

sim_soccer is independent Poisson (no calibration) — Soccer ATGS pick fc87a363 shows sim_wp 31.4 vs model 49.4 = -18pp 'weaker' signal. This is the documented value-add: surfaces totals/ATGS edge cases the matchup-aware model may overrate.

Tennis uses RUNS=3000 (not 10000) per file comment 'tennis is per-point heavy; smaller runs for speed'. Spec didn't mandate 10000 for Tennis, so acceptable. CI half-width is ~1.5pp at n=3000 which is fine.
SimulatorPanel correctly tagline-switches by sport (Poisson goals / per-possession / per-point Markov chain) and SportExtras component renders only the relevant cells per sport with no fallthrough.
Backtest endpoint accepts optional `sport` query param; when set, sport filter is applied to base_query and by_sport is None — correctly tested.
sim_backtest._compute_from_rows handles n=0 path by returning {n:0} without divide-by-zero; bucket logic and odds-to-payout conversion look sound.

success_rate.backend: 100% (22/22 phase B tests + 6/6 phase A tests)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (4/4 sports render SimulatorPanel correctly with sport-specific extras)
